svix_new_application_trigger.description: Runs for each new application in Svix. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields createdAt, id, metadata, name, throttleRate, uid, updatedAt

svix_new_endpoint_attempt_trigger.description: Runs for each new webhook delivery attempt in Svix. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields endpointId, id, msg.channels, msg.deliverAt, msg.eventId, msg.eventType, msg.id, msg.payload, msg.tags, msg.timestamp, msgId, response, responseDurationMs, responseStatusCode, status, statusText, timestamp, triggerType, url

output.record: object with the fields channels, createdAt, description, disabled, eventTypes, expiry, id, metadata, throttleRate, uid, updatedAt, url

parameters.description: The Application's ID or UID.
parameters.name: app_id

svix_new_message_trigger.description: Runs for each new webhook message in Svix. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
